title: THRONE AND LIBERTY

anticheat.note: NCGuard, NCSOFT's anti-cheat, starts before the game. In the one report the game ended with code 0xE0000015 right after NCGuard initialized (highball#746). Whether NCGuard is what refuses Wine isn't measured.

provenance: Reported by AmarokSpiritch (highball#746, 2026-11-18), Apple M4, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, Steam copy: the game doesn't launch. NCGuard's own log shows it installing and initializing for TL.exe, then the game exiting with 0xE0000015 seconds later. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: NCSOFT's MMO, with NCGuard anti-cheat. Doesn't launch in the one report so far, on the default engine with DXMT: NCGuard starts, then the game exits with code 0xE0000015 before any window (highball#746). Other engines and graphics modes haven't been reported.

knownIssues.symptom: The game exits with 0xE0000015 right after NCGuard initializes, before any window (M4, Wine 10 r28, DXMT, highball#746)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. NCGuard, the game's anti-cheat, is the last thing its log shows
